text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is shown in a picture, such as a cat or a car. Another key task is object detection, which means finding and locating multiple objects within an image. Computer vision has many useful applications in our daily lives. For example, it is used in self-driving cars to recognize traffic signs, pedestrians, and other vehicles on the road. It also helps doctors examine medical images and allows phones to unlock using face recognition.
